'''DecipherCon 1999 SW Iron Man''' was a Star Wars CCG side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (11–14 November 1999, Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia). Decipher's score sheet covers 2 games for 9 players and records no winner.<ref name="dc99sw11_2">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW11_2.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: SW Iron Man], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001119195800/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW11_2.html Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Type:''' Side event (SW Iron Man)

== Notes ==

* Daniel Sotelo tops the sheet after 2 games.<ref name="dc99sw11_2" /> The sheet is partial and does not name a winner.
* It is unclear whether this is a separate event from the four-game [[DecipherCon 1999 Iron Man]] sheet (won by Joe Alread), on which several of the same players appear.
